_doc: Budgets for `npm run perf` (the frame-cost gate). The gate is DATA: relative.* caps judge each zone against the SAME run's town control (machine-independent — a slow laptop slows both sides); absolute.* are generous backstops for outright hitching. gapP50Mul/gapP99Mul multiply the town control's percentile, slackMs adds flat headroom so a tiny control (fast machine, vsync floor) never divides into an impossible cap. Hitch rates are per minute of steady-state walking; hitchGraceCount is the quantization guard — a rate breach additionally needs MORE than this many offending frames in the window, because an 8s window can only express 0 or ≥7.5/min and a single stray OS/driver frame is not 'outright hitching' (a pattern still is: two 70ms frames in 8s = 15/min breaches). entryWorstGapMs caps the zone-load burst. THE SKIP GATE (2026-08-01, ratified): a row the walker could not HOLD (a 'hold'-class skip — it stood in the zone and could not keep one clean window pair) gates exit 2 like a breach, because a zone silently dropping out of coverage forever is the exact silence the sweep exists to prevent; 'unmintable' and 'load-fallback' skips stay report-only (the mint machinery said no before a walker stood). The committed waiver for a deliberately unholdable row is overrides.<tileset>.allowSkip: true — carry a _todo and fresh evidence like any override row.
_docDeterminism: The gate rolls NO dice: `weather` pins the sky (a CLI --weather overrides it and flips the run to non-gating forensics), `mintSeed` seeds each tileset's mint from mintSeed + FNV-1a(tileset id) — ID-STABLE, so a row's mint never re-rolls because the registry grew or reordered, and --filter runs reproduce the full sweep's zones by construction. (Until 2026-07-19 seeds derived from the FULL-matrix INDEX; every tileset insertion re-rolled all later rows — the roulette silently swapped sandsea's judged face off 'whaleback swell' and crypt's off 'plague pit'. Adopting id-hash seeds re-rolled every row ONCE; the pins below hold the evidenced heavy faces regardless.) `mintPins` forces a tileset's variant and/or layout generator so multi-modal tilesets are judged on their committed WORST CASE instead of whatever the dice serve — heavy scenes are usually a LAYOUT roll (jungle × the sealed-forest roof), not a variant. A pin may also carry `seed` (outranks the id-hash) — the worst-case lever for tilesets whose heavy scene is a COUNT roll, not a face; hunt one with the CLI `--seed=<n> --filter=<id>` forensics pair. The matrix itself is registry-derived: frontier-eligible tilesets in registry order, then `perfProbe: true` opt-ins (caves, minted interiors) appended. `relative.controlFloorMs` stops a fast town roll (vsync-off 4.2ms pacing) from halving every cap — the control normalizes the machine, never gambles the headroom.
_docHarnessShield: THE HARNESS SHIELD (2026-08-02). THE DEADMAN (launcher/perfdeadman.cjs): the sampler beats `perf:beat` ~1/s (each completed row rides its beat — live progress lines + partial reports); beat silence past the dial runs a two-stage verdict — liveness probes first (a healthy renderer whose beat wiring rotted DISARMS the deadman; it never kills a live run), then in-process CDP pause-stacks (Debugger.enable sent WITHOUT awaiting — a wedged thread never acks): pause lands = JS-hot histogram, pause never lands = 'native wedge'; the run is killed, the partial report files a 'wedge'-class skip row that ALWAYS gates exit 2 (no waiver exists — a wedge is a bug the deadman caught, never a committed fact; forensics runs exit 1 instead: an incomplete run, not a verdict). Dials default in code and an optional top-level `deadman` object here overrides any of them: silenceSec 45, checkSec 5, probeTimeoutSec 2, probeCount 3, pauseDeadlineSec 10, stackCount 10, stackGapMs 300. THE DIRTY-TREE GUARD (perfMode): a stale dist on a DIRTY tree refuses to rebuild and exits 3 (distinct from 0 ok / 1 invalid / 2 breach) unless --allow-dirty deliberately measures WIP bytes — a fresh stamp always proceeds (the stamp digests the dirty content itself, so a matching dist IS the current bytes); every report.json carries dist.stamp, the digest actually measured. THE SLAB COLUMN (src/main.ts PHASE LEDGER): each row's worst frame slab by NAME (pre = vsync-to-callback overhang, i.e. a foreign task wearing the frame's name in taskMx; head = pad/pointer/couch; sim/ren = the standing brackets; tail = post-perfPush net+hostTail, carried one frame late by position) — the self-attribution for gapMax-equals-taskMx rows whose sim99/ren99 sit tiny.
